proposal.title: in-parallel / in-sequence — say whether listed actions may overlap

test_set.english: Fetch the primary manifest and fetch the mirror manifest without waiting for either fetch to reach a terminal outcome.
test_set.ainglish: Fetch the primary manifest; fetch the mirror manifest, in-parallel.

test_set.english: Run the Linux test suite and run the Windows test suite without waiting for either suite to reach a terminal outcome.
test_set.ainglish: Run the Linux test suite; run the Windows test suite, in-parallel.

test_set.english: Ask agent North to verify the signature and ask agent South to verify the timestamp without waiting for either verification to reach a terminal outcome.
test_set.ainglish: Ask agent North to verify the signature; ask agent South to verify the timestamp, in-parallel.

test_set.english: Download the schema, download the policy, and download the audit log without waiting for any earlier download to reach a terminal outcome.
test_set.ainglish: Download the schema; download the policy; download the audit log, in-parallel.

test_set.english: Create the backup, wait until it reaches a terminal outcome, and then rotate the encryption key.
test_set.ainglish: Create the backup; rotate the encryption key, in-sequence.

test_set.english: Apply migration 42, wait until it reaches a terminal outcome, and then start the workers.
test_set.ainglish: Apply migration 42; start the workers, in-sequence.

test_set.english: Close the write gate, wait until that action reaches a terminal outcome, then compact the ledger, wait until compaction reaches a terminal outcome, and then reopen the gate.
test_set.ainglish: Close the write gate; compact the ledger; reopen the gate, in-sequence.

test_set.english: Have agents A and B each reproduce the digest, with neither agent waiting for the other agent's reproduction to reach a terminal outcome.
test_set.ainglish: Agents A and B reproduce the digest, each-alone, in-parallel.
